candidates.description: This feature vector represents first and third-person personal pronouns in various cases and capitalizations.
This vector activates for words, figures, and concepts related to ancient Greek history, philosophy, and mythology.
This vector is related to subwords, prefixes, or suffixes containing the letter 'y'.
This feature vector represents German nouns and verb stems related to work, effort, and mechanisms.
This vector activates German adverbial and verbal prefixes that modify direction, continuation, or state.
This vector represents academic subjects and formal fields of study, particularly mathematics and the sciences.
This vector represents the character 'ä' and common subword variations featuring the letter 'ä' in Germanic languages.
This feature vector activates on tokens starting with the letters "Al" or "Leg".
This vector activates on German personal and reflexive pronouns (along with some noise).
This feature vector activates on German adjectives and quantifiers expressing quantity, variety, and scope, such as "viele," "verschiedene," and "andere."
